design.type: randomized, double-masked (double-dummy), active-controlled, parallel-group, non-inferiority; maintenance therapy after aflibercept induction

arms.name: XYZ-123 ophthalmic solution
arms.regimen: 0.5% once daily (QD) topical to the study eye from randomization (Week 0) through Week 52 [dose provisional; TBD]
arms.masking_double_dummy: sham intravitreal procedure at visits when aflibercept injection would be due in Arm B
arms.src: USER (XYZ-123 eye drop); dose: DERIVED from USER:P2-release (D5)

arms.name: Aflibercept 8 mg intravitreal injection
arms.regimen: All participants: 3 induction injections 4 weeks apart (±7 days) in run-in; then maintenance 8 to 16 weeks apart (±1 week) according to visual and anatomic findings (masked assessment) through Week 52
arms.masking_double_dummy: vehicle eye drops at the same frequency as Arm A
arms.src: USER; label-consistent (Eylea HD PI search excerpt)

periods.run_in_note: aflibercept 8 mg at Run-in Week 0, 4, 8; randomization at Run-in Week 12 (= Week 0)

src.periods: USER(48) + DERIVED(52 for ICH E1, D2)

population.summary: Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration, 50 years and older (Adult, Older Adult), with good response to aflibercept induction [USER; USER:P2-release]

endpoints.text: Reduction of 15 or more letters in BCVA (Best corrected visual acuity) as measured by ETDRS visual acuity chart from baseline Week 48
endpoints.note: Participants who receive rescue therapy by Week 48 are counted as having the event (composite strategy, D3).

endpoints.text: Proportion of participants with a 15-letter or greater BCVA loss from baseline or rescue therapy at any time from Week 8 to Week 52
Time to first occurrence of a 15-letter or greater BCVA loss from baseline or rescue therapy through Week 52
Change from baseline in BCVA (ETDRS letters) at Week 48
Change from baseline in central subfield thickness (CST) by SD-OCT at Week 48
Proportion of participants with no intraretinal fluid and no subretinal fluid in the central subfield at Week 48
Proportion of participants with a reduction of 15 or more letters in BCVA compared with the best BCVA recorded before Week 48 or rescue therapy through Week 48
Change from baseline in NEI VFQ-25 total score at Week 48
Ocular and non-ocular treatment-emergent adverse events, including dry eye and punctate keratitis

intercurrent_events.ice: Rescue therapy for nAMD (aflibercept 8 mg outside the masked schedule)
Permanent discontinuation of randomized treatment without rescue
Other prohibited nAMD treatment in the study eye

supportive: hypothetical strategy for rescue [CTG:NCT04423718 used 'mainly hypothetical']
estimands.population_level_summary: difference in proportions (XYZ-123 minus aflibercept 8 mg) with stratified Newcombe one-sided 97.5% upper confidence bound compared with the NI margin [TBD] [CTG:NCT04270747 method]

rescue.therapy: Intravitreal aflibercept 8 mg given outside the masked schedule when protocol-defined rescue criteria are met [criteria TBD]
rescue.ip_action: Continue randomized treatment and all visits [DERIVED, TBD]
rescue.estimand_ice: Rescue therapy for nAMD (aflibercept 8 mg outside the masked schedule)

rescue.therapy: Other nAMD therapy in the study eye (other anti-VEGF, PDT, vitrectomy)
rescue.ip_action: Discontinue randomized treatment in the study eye? [TBD]
rescue.estimand_ice: Other prohibited nAMD treatment in the study eye

multiplicity.method: fixed-sequence testing of key secondaries only if non-inferiority is shown [DERIVED]

sample_size.note: provisional lower bound; primary NI may require more
